This small report reads the canonical database through DuckDB, loads the
Spatial extension, and checks that the Parquet export is available.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

ROOT = Path.cwd()
db_path = ROOT / "data" / "aussef.duckdb"
parquet_path = ROOT / "data" / "parquet" / "master" / "councils.parquet"

con = duckdb.connect(str(db_path), read_only=True)
con.execute("LOAD spatial")
councils = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM master.councils").fetchone()[0]
duckdb_version = con.execute("PRAGMA version").fetchone()[0]
spatial_loaded = con.execute(
    "SELECT loaded FROM duckdb_extensions() WHERE extension_name = 'spatial'"
).fetchone()[0]
parquet_rows = pq.ParquetFile(parquet_path).metadata.num_rows
con.close()

print({
    "council_rows_in_duckdb": councils,
    "council_rows_in_parquet": parquet_rows,
    "duckdb_version": duckdb_version,
    "spatial_loaded": spatial_loaded,
})
```
